## agmsg desktop app 0.6.1

### New
- Add-ons can take part in a team. With the permissions you allow, an add-on pane can join a team as a member, send and read its messages, and start Claude Code or Codex agents in it. The pane asks first, and the powers can be revoked in Settings > Add-ons. (#1861, #1888)
- An add-on can list the models and efforts a CLI offers, start an agent with a chosen effort, follow the app's language, and learn when a notice was typed into an agent it started. (#1912, #1913, #1918,

- CR strip only where sqlite3 emits CRLF (config/roster readers); keep and show a body with a NUL byte (#1944)
- Keep seat state in memory, not in install.db (#1911)
- Linux: the agmsgd systemd unit gets a PATH that reaches sqlite3 and Node (#1844)

- Add-on panes. The tab bar `+` opens Shell, File view, Diff view, installed add-on panes and Install add-ons. An add-on pane runs in a sandboxed frame and gets only what it declares and you allow: the messages of a team you choose, and the files and git state of a folder you pick. Add-ons cannot run programs, send messages or control agmsg. (#1833)

This release adds plugins from GitHub: `agmsg plugin install <owner>/<repo>` adds a third-party ext-tool, terminal or agent type after showing you every file it can run (and, in chat, offering to have the agent read them first), and keeps it pinned to the commit you approved. It also hardens remote sync against compressed responses from a sync server (CVE-2026-111497); if you use remote sync, update.

## [1.6.1] - 2026-10-25

This release fixes agmsgd notices that could stop and never resume. If you turned agmsgd on in 1.6.0, update; nothing else is needed, and agmsgd restarts on the new code by itself. If agmsgd is off, it stays off, and the recommended setting is unchanged: agmsgd, chosen with `/agmsg delivery`.

- SQLite 3.53.4/3.54.0 CLI compatibility for init rollback and busy diagnostics (#1654)

## What's Changed

This release fixes a set of security and permission issues across the API, login and admin. We recommend all 7.x installs update.

### Security
* API list endpoints no longer accept the `filter`, `with` and `withCount` query parameters, and `orderBy` only sorts on the endpoint's own columns.
* API searches can only filter on the fields each endpoint allows.
* Registration and profile updates only save the fields on their forms.
